scope: Driver instance creation validates JSON object configuration through the registered driver contract before persistence, rejects disabled registrations, and locks the enabled registry row while inserting.
isolation: Tests use mocked connections and synthetic driver implementations. No database, provider, candidate, legacy service, or persistent Docker resource was used.
limitations: Third-party driver configuration validation executes installed package code in-process; installed plugins remain trusted and are not sandboxed.
The mock checks do not prove PostgreSQL row-lock behavior against a live database.
